from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_seps = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    col_seps = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_sep_color = grid[row_seps[0]][0]
    col_sep_color = grid[0][col_seps[0]]
    rs = [-1] + row_seps + [h]
    cs = [-1] + col_seps + [w]
    tiles = []
    for i in range(len(rs) - 1):
        for j in range(len(cs) - 1):
            cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(rs[i] + 1, rs[i + 1])
                     for c in range(cs[j] + 1, cs[j + 1])]
            tiles.extend(cells)
    background = Counter(tiles).most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker_colors = [v for v in set(tiles) if v not in (background, row_sep_color, col_sep_color)]
    marker = marker_colors[0]
    result = []
    for i in range(len(rs) - 1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(cs) - 1):
            cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(rs[i] + 1, rs[i + 1])
                     for c in range(cs[j] + 1, cs[j + 1])]
            row.append(1 if cells.count(marker) == 2 else background)
        result.append(row)
    return result
